content_of_post_to_comment: Hmm. Now you can add a “freewall” to your posts, as in only subscribers (free or paid) can read beyond a certain point in your post. I am not a fan of that because I don’t need more subscriptions in my inbox. So if I come across a random post by a writer I’m unfamiliar with and I have to subscribe to read the rest of it, I’m unlikely to subscribe. Maybe I’m in the minority on that one.
